nurse.text: Alright, my lover! Welcome to Plymouth Sanctuary. Come in out of the wind, it's blowing a hooley off the Sound.
What can we do for you?

then.text: Pop them on the counter. A nice sit down, a bit of quiet, and a cup of tea for you while you wait.
There we are, good as new. Proper job.
The Ark's in the corner by the window. It's been a lovely view of the Hoe all morning.

else.text: Mind how you go, my 'ansum. And don't feed the gulls, it only encourages them.
